title: Architecture: files are the interface
summary: Agents never talk to the viewer. They write files; the viewer reads them. The browser writes back only feedback.md and settings.json.

nodes.label: Codex CLI
nodes.detail: Reads `skills/conductor-view/SKILL.md` like any other skill. Needs **no** special API — only file writes and, optionally, one shell command to start the server.

nodes.label: Claude Code
nodes.detail: Same contract as Codex. Nothing here uses Claude Artifacts or any cloud feature.

nodes.label: Gemini · Cursor · …
nodes.detail: Anything that supports `SKILL.md` folders gets the companion for free.

nodes.label: Conductor skills
nodes.detail: new-track, implement, review, status — each gains a short, **conditional** *Visual companion* hook. Without Python they behave exactly as today.

nodes.label: tracks.md
nodes.detail: Unchanged registry. Parsed for `[ ]` / `[~]` / `[x]` and the link to each track.

nodes.label: spec.md
nodes.detail: Rendered section by section. `(diagram: slug)` becomes a chip that opens a map.

nodes.label: plan.md
nodes.detail: Phases → tasks → sub-tasks with status, commit SHAs and `[checkpoint: sha]`.

nodes.label: diagrams/*.json · *.svg
nodes.detail: New, optional. JSON world maps (nodes, edges, regions, tour) or raw SVG rendered sandboxed as an image.

nodes.label: feedback.md
nodes.detail: One of only **two** files the browser writes (the other is `conductor/settings.json`). Append-only items: `FB-007 · open · comment`, a target, your text, then the agent's `> reply` and the status flipped to `resolved`.

nodes.label: serve.py
nodes.detail: Python 3 standard library only. Binds `127.0.0.1`. `GET /api/state`, `GET /api/version`, `POST /api/feedback`, and `--export` for a single-file snapshot.

nodes.label: Viewer (vanilla JS)
nodes.detail: No build, no CDN, works offline. Polls `/api/version` every 1.5 s and re-renders when anything on disk changes.

nodes.label: World-map canvas
nodes.detail: Full-screen modal. Pan any direction, zoom at cursor, minimap, node details, guided tour. You are looking at it.

nodes.label: You, in a browser
nodes.detail: Review the plan, comment on any task, approve or request changes — then tell the agent *“check feedback”* (or it checks at the next checkpoint).
